name: Options scorecard · weighted criteria for any set of options
purpose: Score any set of options (vendors, platforms or approaches) against weighted criteria in one table with a weighted total row. Neutral: no recommendation or highlighted option.

source_advisory_slots.note: 4-7 criteria; weights total 100%. 3-5 option columns (4 shown at 117 wide).
